column7: REVIEW-3482 F1 (ask 3482-mixed-request-rule (a)): a request that narrows and widens access failed closed as a whole, so an audit outage rolled its revocation back. It is now two commits, narrowing first (owed) and the rest fail closed, at UpdateUser, UpdateSCIMUser, PatchSCIMGroup, ReplaceSCIMGroup, UpdateProject, ReissueOneTimePassword and machine token rotation (IssueMachineToken with ReplaceCredentialID). The test reads the database for 9 mixed requests: under an outage the narrowing is applied with its owed row pending and backfilled once while commit 2's effect and row are absent (PartialMutationError, revocation_applied=true, remainder_applied=false), and a retry completes; also commit-2 append error/effect-then-error/panic, crash after commit 1, record refused, record and append refused (the NOT-queued gap stays a violation). Red on a675a36c: all 9 kinds red in the outage, commit-2-append, crash and gap cases on SQLite and PostgreSQL (the narrowing was not applied).
